messages:
Maya Ortiz: Heads-up from a quick console sweep: the compact toolbar on the dashboard is sitting too close to the content edge at 1200px and mini-toasts slide in and cover the primary CTA. Screenshot uploaded.
Ben Carter: I can repro on staging. The toast animation comes in at viewport bottom and the toolbar is positioned inside the shell, so they collide visually.
Sana Nair: This smells like a spacing token drift between toolbar and shell — toolbar uses `--spacing-toolbar-compact` while other components use the compact scale. We should add a middle token so components align predictably.
Theo Brooks: Current CSS: ```css
.toolbar.compact { padding: var(--spacing-toolbar-compact); }
.mini-toast-container { position: fixed; bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); right: 16px; }
```
Theo Brooks: Proposal: introduce `--spacing-compact-mid` and use it for toolbar bottom padding and for the toast offset calc so the toast respects the shell safe area. e.g. `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--spacing-compact-mid));`
design-bot: lint: token "--spacing-compact-mid" not found in tokens.json. Recommend adding the token and referencing it in toolbar + toast rules (lint-id: token-missing-19788).
Maya Ortiz: Plan: 1) add `--spacing-compact-mid` to the spacing scale; 2) swap toolbar padding to use it; 3) update toast container to use calc with `--shell-bottom` or the new token; 4) ensure z-index ordering so toast appears above sticky footers but below modal overlays.
Ben Carter: I'll own the toast changes. I'm going to move the toast container into `.app-shell` markup so it respects shell variables and set `bottom: calc(var(--shell-bottom) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--spacing-compact-mid));` Running visual diffs. Assigning to @Ben Carter.
Sana Nair: I'll add the token in tokens.yml (`--spacing-compact-mid: 12px`) and swap the toolbar padding. Also keeping icon size the same but expanding hit target to `--button-touch-40` for touch.
Theo Brooks: Accessibility nit: several toolbar icon-only buttons are missing `aria-label` and the focus ring gets clipped because the toolbar had `overflow: hidden`. Ensure `aria-label` on icon buttons and set `overflow: visible` or `outline-offset: 3px`. Add to PR checklist.
Ben Carter: PR for toast anchoring posted (staging link in PR). I moved the container inside `.app-shell` and adjusted bottom calc. Visual diffs uploaded. :thumbsup:
Sana Nair: PR for token + toolbar spacing + a11y fixes opened. Included notes in tokens.yml and a short doc example for when to use `--spacing-compact-mid`. Staging link included.
Maya Ortiz: Quick review done, spot-checked staging at 1200/1024/375 widths. Toasts no longer cover primary CTA, spacing reads better. Focus ring visible when keyboard-tabbing.
Theo Brooks: Ran NVDA/VoiceOver checks for the toolbar. All icon buttons now announce properly thanks to aria-label additions. Tab order is logical.
design-bot: automated re-lint: token `--spacing-compact-mid` present. No blocking issues found. (lint-id: token-added-19788)
Maya Ortiz: Merged both PRs after tiny copy tweak. Thanks all 389 Closing thread.
